about: Held-out synthetic requests for the Laya slice gate, written after the question wording and threshold were fixed on laya-slices.json. Never tune on this file. No private data.

cases.text: Tell me a fun fact about octopuses.
Can you check my grammar? 'Me and him goes to school every days.'
What's 15% of 240?
Describe the main causes of the First World War briefly.
Help me write a thank-you note to our guest speaker.

源氏物語ってどんなお話？簡単に。
